title: US Secretary of State highlights investment in Lesotho
excerpt: Secretary of State Marco Rubio noted a $6.2 billion hydropower and data center project during Lesotho's 60th independence anniversary.
bodyHtml:
The US State Department announced on October 4, 2026, that the United States is working to strengthen commercial ties with Lesotho. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that the United States remains committed to strategic investments in the nation.

The statement identified a $6.2 billion hydropower and data center project by Convalt Energy as a key component of this partnership. The announcement was made as Lesotho commemorates 60 years of independence.

In the statement, Secretary of State Marco Rubio extended his congratulations to His Majesty King Letsie III and the people of Lesotho. The United States also noted that it is building on the close cooperation it shares with the nation in health and security.

The United States remains committed to these strategic investments as the country marks this historic occasion. The $6.2 billion hydropower and data center project by Convalt Energy serves as a primary example of the commercial ties between the two nations.
